messages.content: Predict the total expected profit of stocks XYZ in 5 years given I have invested $5000 and annual return rate is 7%.

function.name: investment_predictProfit

Profit = 7012.75-5000=2012.75. So about $2013. Alternatively if r=7, then huge. So we assume decimal. We'll produce answer: $2013 approx.
